metadata.database: A Deeper China | Shenzhen point decision layer

guest_name_map.SZ006: Metro, delivery and payment as urban interface
guest_name_map.SZ009: Shenzhen Bay / Talent Park public realm

SZ001.guest_value: Turn a vague tech interest into one observable public question.
SZ001.choose_rule: Use before promising hardware, company, factory or campus content.
SZ001.stop_after: The visitor has one technology question and a public evidence path.

SZ002.guest_value: Read components, supply-chain language and market behaviour without bargain folklore.
SZ002.choose_rule: Use for public observation; separate personal buying from sourcing.
SZ002.stop_after: One supply-chain pattern is understood and the visitor leaves before overload.

SZ003.guest_value: Clarify whether the visitor is observing, buying a personal item or sourcing.
SZ003.choose_rule: No quality, price, supplier or authenticity promise from a market visit.
SZ003.stop_after: The visitor has made a bounded personal decision or explicitly stopped at observation.

SZ004.guest_value: Use a public showroom or flagship to observe consumer-facing technology.
SZ004.choose_rule: Choose only when the current public programme/access fits; no company relationship implied.
SZ004.stop_after: One user-facing technology pattern is understood.

SZ005.guest_value: Provide an exhibition-led technology frame on a rainy or high-heat day.
SZ005.choose_rule: Choose by current exhibition and age/interest fit, not venue name alone.
SZ005.stop_after: One technology/history question is answered; no museum marathon.

SZ006.guest_value: Show technology through metro, delivery and payment in ordinary use.
SZ006.choose_rule: Use public observation only; do not solicit private user data or photograph identifiable people without consent.
SZ006.stop_after: One interface pattern and one human friction are clear.

SZ007.guest_value: Balance the hardware story with public design and creative reuse.
SZ007.choose_rule: Select by current programme and venue access, not a guaranteed workshop.

SZ008.guest_value: Potentially add a making perspective if public access and language fit.
SZ008.choose_rule: No workshop, maker or studio access promise until owner consent and programme are verified.
SZ008.stop_after: The public making question is answered without private access.

SZ009.guest_value: Read innovation-city ambition through bay, park, public realm and talent infrastructure.
SZ009.choose_rule: Use as an urban systems observation, not a company-campus tour.
SZ009.stop_after: The visitor can link public space, transport, housing/work and innovation.

SZ010.guest_value: Observe the relationship between retail, design and Nanshan’s growth.
SZ010.choose_rule: Include only when current city energy is the question, not as generic shopping.

SZ011.guest_value: Show historical and lived texture inside a technology-city trip.
SZ011.choose_rule: Use one public street question; avoid authenticity claims and private access.

SZ012.guest_value: Connect Shenzhen’s technology story to port, migration and public waterfront life.
SZ012.choose_rule: Choose only if port-city history adds a new question.

SZ013.guest_value: Give one day a bounded technology core: intent, public market/interface and one city-system contrast.
SZ013.choose_rule: Use as a skeleton, not a company-access itinerary.
SZ013.stop_after: The guest has one technology question answered with public evidence.

SZ014.guest_value: Use two days for hardware/technology plus design or urban systems, not more company names.
SZ014.choose_rule: Add a second question only when the first day’s evidence has been understood.
SZ014.stop_after: Each day answers a different public technology question.

SZ015.guest_value: Replace factory/campus requests with public evidence and explain why.
SZ015.choose_rule: Never imply private company access, supplier meetings or R&D tours.
SZ015.stop_after: The visitor accepts the public route or the request is declined.

SZ016.guest_value: Set rules for market photography, IP, faces, prototypes and commercial filming.
SZ016.choose_rule: Consent and venue rules override the visitor’s visual goal.
SZ016.stop_after: The visitor has a public composition without intrusive or restricted capture.

SZ017.guest_value: Frame Guangzhou and Shenzhen as trade/heritage versus technology/urban systems.
SZ017.choose_rule: Require minimum nights and explicit contrast question.
SZ017.stop_after: The transfer adds a new question and the visitor accepts the cost.

SZ018.guest_value: Make a Hong Kong crossing a current passport/visa/border decision, not a casual extension.
SZ018.choose_rule: Use official current confirmation for the exact traveller and date.
SZ018.stop_after: Eligibility, border timing and return/overnight plan are clear.

SZ019.guest_value: Protect airport/departure days from timing and payment failure.
SZ019.choose_rule: Build from flight, hotel, luggage and latest safe departure time.
SZ019.stop_after: The visitor reaches the next transport with buffer.

SZ020.guest_value: Explain what this product can and cannot sell in a technology city.
SZ020.choose_rule: Offer research/public observation and a human-checked roadbook only; no sourcing or corporate access.
SZ020.stop_after: The visitor understands the boundary and chooses a public route.
